image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin, bare twig against a snowy white background. The bird exhibits non-breeding plumage with a brownish-grey head and back, an orange-rufous breast fading to a white belly, and distinct black wings with white bars. Its bill is conical and yellowish-grey. The bird's feet are gripping the twig securely.
